Low expectations of AI: it gives you courage and the assist

Now the exceptions, because this matters. The protection isn't absolute.
A director can still be personally liable for wrongful or fraudulent trading, personal guarantees, an overdrawn director's loan account, or paying one creditor first. That's why the practitioner decides.
Understand the basics, because even the people closest to you won't get what you're really doing.
And keep your expectations of AI low: it gives you the courage and the assist you need.
Most people get stuck in red tape and can't move.
